steps.title: Load sample dilution buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense sample dilution buffer from the 12‑well reservoir into the Greiner 96‑well plate using the P300 multichannel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 270 µL to well A1.
Transfer 150 µL to wells B1‑H1 (same tips).
Transfer 126 µL to all wells in columns 3, 5, 7, 9, 11.

steps.title: Create calibrator serial dilution
steps.instruction: Perform a 7‑step serial dilution of the calibrator across columns A‑G using the P300 multichannel pipette, mixing after each transfer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 30 µL pre‑diluted calibrator stock to A1 and mix 5 times.
Transfer 150 µL from A1 to B1 and mix 5 times.
Transfer 150 µL from B1 to C1 and mix 5 times.
Transfer 150 µL from C1 to D1 and mix 5 times.
Transfer 150 µL from D1 to E1 and mix 5 times.
Transfer 150 µL from E1 to F1 and mix 5 times.
Transfer 150 µL from F1 to G1 and mix 5 times.

steps.title: Add positive and negative controls
steps.instruction: Add control samples to the Greiner plate using the P20 single‑channel pipette and mix briefly.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 14 µL positive control to well G3 and mix 3‑5 times.
Transfer 14 µL negative control to well H3 and mix 3‑5 times.

steps.title: Add RBD‑HRP to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense RBD‑HRP solution from column 2 of the 12‑well reagent reservoir to the specified columns of the Greiner plate with the P300 multichannel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 120 µL to all wells in column 2.
Transfer 120 µL to all wells in columns 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 (tips may be reused).

steps.title: Transfer columns for assay setup
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multichannel pipette, move 120 µL from each source column to its adjacent destination column and mix twice; complete steps 15‑20 in less than 2 minutes total.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 120 µL from column 1 to column 2, mix 2×.
Transfer 120 µL from column 3 to column 4, mix 2×.
Transfer 120 µL from column 5 to column 6, mix 2×.
Transfer 120 µL from column 7 to column 8, mix 2×.
Transfer 120 µL from column 9 to column 10, mix 2×.
Transfer 120 µL from column 11 to column 12, mix 2×.

steps.title: Incubate plate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Immediately after step 20, move the Greiner 96‑well plate to the temperature module in slot 9 set to 37 °C and incubate for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Duplicate Greiner wells onto Costar plate
steps.instruction: Aspirate 200 µL from each source column of the Greiner plate and dispense 100 µL into the two corresponding columns of the Costar 96‑well strip plate; increase aspirated volume if needed. Complete steps 22‑27 in less than 2 minutes total.

substeps.instruction: Column 2 → Costar columns 1 & 2.
Column 4 → Costar columns 3 & 4.
Column 6 → Costar columns 5 & 6.
Column 8 → Costar columns 7 & 8.
Column 10 → Costar columns 9 & 10.
Column 12 → Costar columns 11 & 12.

steps.title: Incubate Costar plate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place the Costar 96‑well strip plate on the temperature block in slot 9 and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Aspirate residual volume from Costar
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multichannel pipette, aspirate 100 µL from all wells of each column of the Costar plate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 100 µL from column 1, then repeat for columns 2‑12.

steps.title: Perform four wash cycles
steps.instruction: Execute four consecutive washes with wash buffer (260 µL per well) on the Costar plate, keeping tips for each column throughout the washes.

substeps.instruction: For each wash (repeat 4×):
a. Transfer 260 µL wash buffer to all wells of a column (start with column 1, repeat for columns 2‑12, reuse tips).
b. Aspirate 260 µL from the same column, retaining tips for the next wash.

steps.title: Add TMB substrate
steps.instruction: Add light‑sensitive TMB to the assay and distribute it to the Costar plate.

substeps.instruction: Add approximately 10 mL TMB solution to column 3 of the 12‑well reagent reservoir.
Transfer 100 µL TMB from column 3 to all wells of the Costar plate, proceeding column by column (1 → 12).

steps.title: Develop color in dark
steps.instruction: Remove the Costar plate from the OT‑2 and incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature in the dark (e.g., a drawer).

steps.title: Add stop solution to plate
steps.instruction: Add light‑sensitive stop solution to each well of the Costar plate after TMB development.

substeps.instruction: Fill column 4 of the 12‑well reagent reservoir with ~5 mL stop solution.
Transfer 50 µL stop solution to all wells of columns 1 through 12 (one column at a time).

steps.title: Read plate at 450 nm
steps.instruction: Remove the Costar plate from the OT‑2 and read immediately on the MultiSkan FC photometer at 450 nm.
